problemSignature.symptom: quick report was wired to the full target-90 regression and timed out before giving a useful health signal

rootCause: The quick report script reused the full 90-percent fixture execution path, including slow project generation and heavyweight reports, so it behaved like a full regression instead of a bounded smoke/evidence report.
fixSummary: Add explicit --quick mode to boardforge-regression with a small fixture subset, cached clean odd-shape evidence, static honest-failure guards, skipped heavyweight 90-percent reports, and a test that verifies quick mode stays bounded.

testsAdded: report 90 quick mode runs bounded fixture subset

conditions: Use quick report for fast platform health checks
Use full report:90 for broad fresh fixture execution
Never treat quick mode as manufacturing proof for new boards

recipe: Add a dedicated quick-mode flag instead of overloading full regression.
Select a small stable fixture subset.
Use cached validated fixture evidence only when a manifest exists.
Keep honest-failure fixtures in the quick check so blocked states remain tested.
Skip heavyweight audit/category/deep repair reports in quick mode.
Print quickMode and selectedFixtureIds in the machine-readable output.
safetyRules: Do not modify protected ESC/FC projects.
Do not fake readiness: quick mode may report targetReached false.
Do not export manufacturing artifacts from quick-mode-only evidence.

before.report90Quick: timed out while running the full regression path

after.report90Quick: completed successfully in bounded quick mode
